categories.discovery: Understand product intent, technical reality, or UX evidence before a plan exists. Discovery modes do not compete with each other.
categories.product: Evaluate the visual/UI/UX quality of a rendered, navigable digital product from live evidence.
categories.planning: Turn a validated discovery handoff (or a bounded change brief) into an implementation-ready, spec-driven plan.
categories.orchestration: Assign validated plan tasks to registered AI models and reviewers by capability, risk, and cost.
categories.execution: Implement exactly one routed task against its contract and record evidence.
categories.quality: Independently verify implementation evidence against the plan and routing contracts before release.
categories.release: Confirm release gates, checklists, and readiness before shipping and after release.
categories.maintenance: Author, repair, or validate skills, catalog entries, and repository-level contracts.
